_comment: Maps an embedding model's FINGERPRINT to the collection suffix holding vectors produced by it, PER BACKEND. Resolve at CALL TIME from the endpoint actually in use, not from the Support Models default, so a tool using a different model reaches its own collections.
_fingerprint_algorithm: sha1(f'{model_id}|{root}')[:12], where model_id and root come from GET <embed_base>/models. The served NAME alone is insufficient — the same name covers multiple quants; the weights `root` path is what distinguishes them. NOTE the root path is a stable IDENTIFIER, not a trustworthy DESCRIPTION (the downloader files INT8 models under BF16-Safetensors/), so human labels below are assigned deliberately, never parsed from the path.
_id_warning: Point IDs are NOT comparable across suffixes — 1022 docs were re-keyed by the dedup fix 2026-07-25. Match on payload doc_id.

_per_backend_note: The suffix differs per backend because the same encoding can sit under different physical names. Right now qdrant's 4-bit set is SUFFIXED (__bnb4) because the FP8 re-embed took the un-suffixed names, whereas weaviate/chroma were never re-embedded so their 4-bit data is still the BASE name. Renaming to make them uniform is not worth it — weaviate classes cannot be renamed in place (you would copy 64 classes / ~6GB), so we encode the difference here instead.
